evals.prompt: Run the convergence check on a workspace with one OPEN claim C-001 (evidence_tier_attempted=0, boundary_type=positive_observation, no blockers, no depends_on). The claim-register.yaml lists C-001 with status OPEN. The convergence_check.py script must return DISPATCH (exit 1). The orchestrator reads the priority.py output and dispatches a worker agent for the top-ranked action before the round ends.
evals.expected_output: The orchestrator dispatches a worker agent for C-001 following priority.py ordering. convergence_check.py returns exit code 1 (DISPATCH). The round transcript includes a dispatch event targeting C-001. No claims remain OPEN without an attempt to dispatch within the same round.
expectations: convergence_check.py reads claim-register.yaml and identifies C-001 as OPEN
The orchestrator dispatches a worker for C-001 as the first action (priority.py top result)
The round transcript contains a dispatch event for claim C-001
No idle loop occurs: the orchestrator does not proceed to monitoring or verification without first dispatching

evals.prompt: A kunglao-worker agent has produced facts/F050.md with a conclusion and anchors for claim C-050. The fact contains reproduce commands (anchors) and expected values. Run blind verification: a verifier agent (different context than the worker) must independently execute the anchor commands, compare actual output to expected values, and issue a passes verdict. The worker's own self-declared PROVEN status must not be accepted without the independent verifier's confirmation.
evals.expected_output: The verifier independently runs the reproduction commands from F050's anchors, compares the actual output to the expected values, and writes a passes result. The claim C-050 transitions to PROVEN only after the verifier's independent passes. The worker's self-stamp is treated as STAMP (not PROVEN) until the checker confirms.
expectations: The verifier is a different agent or context than the worker that produced F050
The verifier reads only the anchors (commands + expected values) from F050, not the conclusion text
The verifier independently executes each anchor command and compares the actual output to the expected value
The claim transitions to PROVEN only after the independent verifier issues a passes verdict
No self-stamping: the worker's own verification does not promote the claim to PROVEN

evals.prompt: Given a converged workspace where all claims are PROVEN, run the verdict-scorer agent with a task_spec whose primary_questions are all answered by PROVEN facts. The verdict v11 contract (analysis_verdict schema, schema_version 2026-08-12-v11) scores PQ-coverage and fact-citation validity ONLY: every primary_question gets an answered/cited_fact/confidence_band/gap entry, contradictions come from the fact_contradiction_gate output, and degraded[] records self-honest evidence gaps. Out-of-scope capabilities (maliciousness scoring, attribution, threat-actor classification) are banned from the verdict by contract and must not appear.
evals.expected_output: The verdict-scorer writes evidence/verdict.json with the analysis_verdict v11 schema: schema_version "2026-08-12-v11", sample_sha256, analysis_verdict{complete, correct, primary_questions[], unresolved, contradictions, degraded}, and self_audit{evidence_strength, ignored_evidence, open_questions}. Every primary_question is answered with a cited PROVEN fact and a confidence_band; complete=true only when all questions meet C0a/C0b. The verdict does NOT contain an out-of-scope capability section (no maliciousness object, no attribution section) because those are banned by the v11 contract.
expectations: The verdict output contains an analysis_verdict object with schema_version 2026-08-12-v11
PQ-coverage is scored per primary_question: answered / cited_fact / confidence_band / gap; gap is null when answered
contradictions[] is populated only from fact_contradiction_gate output, never re-derived ad hoc
self_audit.evidence_strength is one of: strong, mixed, weak; degraded[] records honest evidence gaps
The verdict does NOT contain a 'maliciousness' or 'attribution' section (out-of-scope capabilities banned by v11)
complete=true only when every primary_question has an answering fact meeting C0a/C0b requirements
